primary_source_grounding.uart_rs485_conf: TRM v1.8 register 26.17 UART_RS485_CONF_REG (0x004C): bit0 UART_RS485_EN, bit1 DL0_EN (1-bit turnaround delay before the start bit), bit2 DL1_EN (1-bit turnaround delay after the stop bit), bit3 RS485TX_RX_EN (receiver works while transmitting), bit4 RS485RXBY_TX_EN (transmitter sends while the receiver line is busy), bits[9:6] TX_DLY_NUM, bit5 RX_DLY_NUM. The model's usage matches this map; the vector previously omitted bit4 for the mirror rows.
